concept.title: Age requirements
concept.shortdesc: Conditions based on a person's age, such as being a young child, over 16, an adult, or in later life.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : A minimum age in later life, such as over 50, 55, 65 or 75.
: A minimum age of 16, including 16-19 provision.
: Children of pre-school or nursery age, or other early years or primary age conditions such as 2 to 4 or up to 5.
: Needing consent or permission from a parent, guardian, family or other person before using or taking part in a service.
: Services for adults, usually 18 or over, or at an advanced level.
